jobDescription:

ROLE:
Logitech is looking for Kinaxis Rapid Response Senior Analyst with 12+ years’ experience in delivering projects in Supply Chain Management and 5+ years of experience in Kinaxis Rapid Response Implementations. This role must have strong analytical and configuration experience in both Rapid response and Oracle e BS (R12 / Fusion) The role involves delivering end to end planning solutions for global Operations planning, including the specific planning development to support different business segments across Consumer, Logitech for Business and, DTX e-commerce. The role involves the development of future state capabilities across component planning, build planning (Master Production Scheduling) as well as advancing our Kinaxis Agentic and AI capabilities. The candidate will need to have the flexibility to support specific shift patterns as part of our global 24x6 support coverage to the global operations business function. Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. These are the behaviors you’ll need for success at Logitech. QUALIFICATIONS:

Responsible for the architect of an Agentic Supply Chain, where AI agents autonomously monitor, reason, and recommend actions to improve the plan accuracy and to manage anomalies in planning data and parameters Act as the point of contact for technical and supply chain disruptions to provide coverage across all the regions. Strong functional knowledge and experience in the following Rapid Response applications: Supply Planning, Capacity Planning (Constraints), DRP, MPS, Demand Planning, Component Planning and Order fulfillment Experience in Oracle e BS Supply chain modules Order Management, Pricing, Inventory, Purchasing, i Store, and i Supplier Implementation experience in configuring Supply planning Demand planning, Order fulfilment modules Hand on experience in performance tuning, bug fixing & application upgrade in Kinaxis application Must have knowledge of integrating Kinaxis with Oracle ERP systems Should have experience in Agile project management practice. ROLE:
We are seeking a seasoned Firmware Automation Engineer with expertise in Python, USB verification and deep knowledge of advanced testing frameworks to ensure the delivery of high-quality peripherals in consumer technology. As a Product QA professional, you will drive the development and improvement of our automated test frameworks for cutting-edge peripheral devices. This position requires strong analytical skills, technical expertise, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Perform basic debugging and troubleshooting. Document test procedures, results, and contribute to user-friendly tool documentation. Collaborate with validation engineers to ensure test coverage and product quality. Learn and apply best practices in test design, automation, and quality assurance. Key

For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team: 3+ years of experience in software testing, automation, or embedded systems validation. Exposure to manual and automated testing methodologies. Ability to understand and execute detailed test plans and procedures. Knowledge of electronics engineering fundamentals. Hands-on assembly and wiring of electronic test benches, including integration of sensors, connectors, and harnesses. Debugging and troubleshooting of electronic circuits, signal integrity, and connectivity issues. Familiarity with communication protocols such as UART,USB, Ethernet, Bluetooth. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
